summary: Garze Gesar Airport is a small regional airport in the Garzê Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture of Sichuan Province, China, serving the remote high-altitude town of Garzê. Named after King Gesar, the legendary warrior-king of the Tibetan epic tradition, the airport provides a vital air link to one of China's most isolated and culturally rich Tibetan regions. It primarily handles short-haul domestic flights connecting travelers to the broader Sichuan transportation network.
